comparison.objective: Coat violin-bow hair with rosin and return the bow; candidate breaks and recovers HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated sliding contact while holding rosin differs from coaxial insertion, bimanual hammering, impact regulation, withdrawal, and fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Hair coated white along most of its length, bow returned, and arms reset versus four physical fractures and recovered tangs without damage.
comparison.reason: The mechanisms and measured outcomes are unrelated despite both using two hands and controlled contact.
